title: Fulfillment Method
description: A fulfillment method with destinations and groups.

type.description: Fulfillment method type. Well-known values: `shipping`, `pickup`. Businesses MAY use additional values.

line_item_ids.description: Line item IDs fulfilled via this method.

destinations.description: Available destinations for this method. In Business responses, each destination carries a `type` and `id`.

selected_destination_id.description: ID of the selected destination. Accepts any stable, Business-scoped ID the Business recognizes for this method, including Location IDs not yet enumerated in `destinations`.

groups.description: Fulfillment groups for selecting options. Agent sets selected_option_id on groups to choose shipping method.

destinations.description: Platform-authored shipping addresses for this method.
Business-authored business locations able to fulfill this method. Response-only: the Platform selects one via `selected_destination_id`, never writes one.
